arxiv-2107-03990.title: Classification of 7-dimensional solvable Lie algebras having 5-dimensional nilradicals
arxiv-2107-03990.creator: Vu A. Le a , Tuan A. Nguyen b , Tu T. C. Nguyen c,d , Tuyen T. M. Nguyen c,e and Thieu N. Vo f
arxiv-2107-03990.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vu A. Le a , Tuan A. Nguyen b , Tu T. C. Nguyen c,d , Tuyen T. M. Nguyen c,e and Thieu N. Vo f. This paper presents a classification of 7-dimensional real and complex indecomposable solvable Lie algebras having some 5-dimensional nilradicals.

arxiv-2202-00225.title: Effective polarization in proton-induced α \alpha knockout reactions Preprint: NITEP 129
arxiv-2202-00225.creator: Tomoatsu Edagawa, Kazuki Yoshida, Yoshiki Chazono, Kazuyuki Ogata
arxiv-2202-00225.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tomoatsu Edagawa, Kazuki Yoshida, Yoshiki Chazono, Kazuyuki Ogata. The effective polarization of the residual nucleus in the proton-induced α \alpha knockout reaction is investigated within the distorted wave impulse approximation framework. The strong absorption of the emitted α \alpha particle results in strong selectivity on the reaction “position” depending on the third component of the single-particle orbital angular momentum of the α \alpha particle inside a nucleus, hence on the spin direction of the reaction residue.

arxiv-2205-06295.title: MORE DOUBLETS AND SINGLETS
arxiv-2205-06295.creator: T. ROBENS
arxiv-2205-06295.description: Abstract I give an overview on models that extend the Standard Model scalar sector by additional gauge singlets or multiplets. I discuss current constraints on such models, as well as possible signatures and discovery prospects at current and future colliders.

arxiv-2403-18029.title: Exact and Leading Order Radiative Effects in Semi-inclusive Deep Inelastic Scattering
arxiv-2403-18029.creator: Igor Akushevich, Stanislav Srednyak, Alexander Ilyichev
arxiv-2403-18029.description: Abstract Radiative effects in semi-inclusive hadron leptoproduction of unpolarized particles are calculated within the leading order approximation. The contributions of the infrared-free sum of the effects of real and virtual photon emission as well as the contribution of exclusive radiative tail are considered.

arxiv-2404-15678.title: Retrieval and Distill: A Temporal Data Shift-Free Paradigm for Online Recommendation System DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2404-15678.creator: Lei Zheng, Ning Li, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu
arxiv-2404-15678.description: Abstract . Current recommendation systems are significantly affected by a serious issue of temporal data shift, which is the inconsistency between the distribution of historical data and that of online data. Most existing models focus on utilizing updated data, overlooking the transferable, temporal data shift-free information that can be learned from shifting data.

arxiv-2412-01753.title: Human-Machine Interfaces for Subsea Telerobotics: From Soda-straw to Natural Language Interactions
arxiv-2412-01753.creator: Adnan Abdullah, David Blow, Ruo Chen, Thanakon Uthai, Eric Jing Du, Md Jahidul Islam
arxiv-2412-01753.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Adnan Abdullah, David Blow, Ruo Chen, Thanakon Uthai, Eric Jing Du, Md Jahidul Islam. This review explores the evolution of human-machine interfaces (HMIs) in subsea telerobotics, charting the progression from traditional first-person “soda-straw" consoles– characterized by narrow field-of-view camera feeds– to contemporary interfaces leveraging gesture recognition, virtual reality, and natural language processing.

arxiv-2503-08212.title: Cloud populations versus galactic environment in NGC 4689, NGC 628, NGC 1566 and NGC 4321
arxiv-2503-08212.creator: Helena Faustino Vieira, Ana Duarte-Cabral, Matthew W. L. Smith, Dario Colombo, Timothy A. Davis, Zein Bazzi
arxiv-2503-08212.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Helena Faustino Vieira, Ana Duarte-Cabral, Matthew W. L. Smith, Dario Colombo, Timothy A. Davis, Zein Bazzi. The study of molecular clouds in galaxies beyond the Local Group is limited by the need to efficiently sample diverse galactic environments across galactic discs, typically resulting in a loss of resolution. Using a high-resolution dust extinction technique, we image the dust (and gas) of 4 nearby galaxies (<18 Mpc; NGC 4689, NGC 628, NGC 1566, and NGC 4321) with resolutions between 5–9 pc.

arxiv-2602-08302.title: Grokking in Linear Models for Logistic Regression
arxiv-2602-08302.creator: Nataraj Das, Atreya Vedantam, Chandrasekhar Lakshminarayanan
arxiv-2602-08302.description: Abstract Grokking, the phenomenon of delayed generalization, is often attributed to the depth and compositional structure of deep neural networks. We study grokking in one of the simplest possible settings: the learning of a linear model with logistic loss for binary classification on data that are linearly (and max margin) separable about the origin.

pmc-10623853.title: Factors influencing French community pharmacists’ willingness to participate in research projects: a mixed method study
pmc-10623853.creator: Arthur Piraux, Morgane Angibaud, Pierre Nizet, Dominique Navas, Claire Sallenave-Namont, Sonia Prot-Labarthe, Jean-François Huon
pmc-10623853.description: BackgroundFrench community pharmacists are facing an increasing demand to provide a wider range of services to meet the needs of the population. These new missions must be evaluated by primary care research studies. This study aims to explore the factors that influence French community pharmacists’ willingness to participate in research projects.

pmc-10636402.title: rTMS targeted to the secondary somatosensory cortex influences sleep in CRPS patients, as measured with the OURA ring
pmc-10636402.creator: Jukka Vanhanen, Jan Kujala, Mia Liljeström, Eija Kalso, Jussi Virkkala, Hanna Harno
pmc-10636402.description: IntroductionChronic pain associates with various sleep problems. Patients with complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS) often report impaired sleep, but objective measurements of sleep in CRPS patients are scarce. Neuromodulation with repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) can alleviate pain and improve sleep.

pmc-10729001.title: Protocol optimization and reducing dropout in online research
pmc-10729001.creator: Halee Staggs, Colleen Mills-Finnerty
pmc-10729001.description: Online research has advantages over in-person research; it’s cost-efficient, scalable, and may increase diversity. Researchers collecting data online can assess protocol performance with classification models like a decision tree. However, challenges include attrition, lack of testing environment controls, technical limitations, and lack of face-to-face rapport and real time feedback.

pmc-11349983.title: miR-29 is an important driver of aging-related phenotypes
pmc-11349983.creator: Vijay Swahari, Ayumi Nakamura, Emilie Hollville, Yu-Han Hung, Matt Kanke, C. Lisa Kurtz, Xurde M. Caravia, David Roiz-Valle, Shenghui He, Janakiraman Krishnamurthy, Sahil Kapoor, Varun Prasad, Cornelius Flowers, Matt Beck, Jeanette Baran-Gale, Norman Sharpless, Carlos López-Otín, Praveen Sethupathy,
pmc-11349983.description: Aging is a consequence of complex molecular changes, but whether a single microRNA (miRNA) can drive aging remains unclear. A miRNA known to be upregulated during both normal and premature aging is miR-29. We find miR-29 to also be among the top miRNAs predicted to drive aging-related gene expression changes.

pmc-11398268.title: Multi-Scale Spatio-Temporal Attention Networks for Network-Scale Traffic Learning and Forecasting
pmc-11398268.creator: Cong Wu, Hui Ding, Zhongwang Fu, Ning Sun, Sung-Bae Cho
pmc-11398268.description: Accurate and timely forecasting of traffic on local road networks is crucial for deploying effective dynamic traffic control, advanced route planning, and navigation services. This task is particularly challenging due to complex spatio-temporal dependencies arising from non-Euclidean spatial relations in road networks and non-linear temporal dynamics influenced by changing road conditions.

pmc-11494584.title: The prognostic factors of clinical outcomes in non-small cell lung cancer patients receiving subsequent treatments after progression on initial immunotherapy
pmc-11494584.creator: Siyun Fu, Zhendong Lu, Song Wei, Zhaoxin Chen, Junfang Tang, Jinghui Wang
pmc-11494584.description: BackgroundThe standard of care for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients who encounter progression on initial immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) based treatment is uncertain. In the real world, there are various subsequent treatment options, but how to find the most suitable treatment for different patients is still unknown.

pmc-11674290.title: Identification and Validation of qRT-PCR Reference Genes for Analyzing Arabidopsis Responses to High-Temperature Stress
pmc-11674290.creator: Siyu Chen, Qi Cai, Peipei Liu, Jingru Liu, Guanzhou Chen, Hanwei Yan, Han Zheng
pmc-11674290.description: Quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) is an essential tool for analyzing and selecting stable reference genes. In order to screen for suitable reference genes under high-temperature stress conditions in Arabidopsis, this study measured the relative expression levels of 17 candidate reference genes using qRT-PCR.

pmc-12383968.title: Ferroptosis as a Therapeutic Avenue in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: Mechanistic Insights and Prognostic Potential
pmc-12383968.creator: Taimoor Riaz, Muhammad Ali Saleem, Muhammad Umar Muzafar Khan, Muhammad Abdul Rehman Rashid, Muhammad Zubair
pmc-12383968.description: Background and Aims: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a clinically aggressive malignancy marked by rapid disease progression, limited therapeutic avenues, and high recurrence risk. Ferroptosis an iron-dependent, lipid peroxidation-driven form of regulated cell death that has emerged as a promising therapeutic vulnerability in oncology.

pmc-12766774.title: Affinity-matured CD72-targeting nanobody CAR T cells enhance elimination of antigen-low B-cell malignancies
pmc-12766774.creator: Adila Izgutdina, Tasfia Rashid, William C Temple, Sarah Aminov, Bonell Patiño-Escobar, Sujata Walunj, Huimin Geng, Hiroyuki Takamatsu, Daniel Gil-Alós, Amrik S Kang, Emilio Ramos, Szu-Ying Chen, Haley Johnson, Matthew A Nix, Akul Naik, Mingcheng Li, Constance M Yuan, Hao-Wei Wang, Srabani Sahu, Rebe
pmc-12766774.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapies are highly efficacious for several different hematologic cancers. However, for most CAR T targets it is observed that low surface antigen density on tumors can significantly reduce therapeutic efficacy.

pmc-13367350.title: Optimization of Xiaoer Lingyin granule formulation using single-factor and response surface methodology
pmc-13367350.creator: Yanru Liu, Taoyang Cai, S. K. Kot-Cheung, Xinli Song, Feixiong Chen
pmc-13367350.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study aimed to develop and optimize Xiaoer Lingyin granules (XLGs), a pediatric traditional Chinese medicine formulation for acute pharyngitis, by integrating single-factor experiments, multi-index quality evaluation, and response surface methodology (RSM). Key formulation and process variables, including drug-to-excipient ratio, ethanol concentration, ethanol dosage, drying temperature, and drying time, were systematically evaluated to improve granule formability, flowability, dissolution performance, and palatability.

pmc-13581482.title: Integrated postpartum family planning utilization with maternal health services and associated factors in governmental hospitals of northeast Ethiopia: institution-based cross-sectional study
pmc-13581482.creator: Delelegn Tsegaye Zikie, Misra Abdulahi Ahmed, Gurmesa Tura Debelew
pmc-13581482.description: Introductionpostpartum family planning (PPFP) is one of the least utilized reproductive health services in Ethiopia. Its integration with maternal health services helps to improve postpartum contraceptive use. Although integrating PPFP with maternal health services can improve postpartum contraceptive uptake, implementation of integrated services remains suboptimal in many settings.
